verdict.rationale: Pandoc's own docs mention an HTTP server mode (pandoc-server) that can be compiled in, and the converter can fetch input from a URL and write an output file, so a first-party conversion API exists. The evidence for it is only a single thin line. Nothing shows an async job model with visible status, and the pack documents no request/response contract (the OpenAPI probe found nothing). missing for 10: documented server API endpoints for upload/URL input, job-based execution with status polling, documented return of the output file, independent corroboration of the server mode.
